title: Skull of Gul'dan
wikitext:
{{Stub}}After [[Gul'dan]] died, his skull was turned into a channeling totem for demonic energy.  The skull was used by [[Ner'zhul]] to open portals to other worlds on [[Draenor]].  Years later it would appear again on [[Azeroth]], this time used by the [[Burning Legion]] to corrupt the forests of [[Felwood]].  The skull was eventually destroyed by [[Illidan]] Stormrage, who absorbed its power, becoming half [[Night Elf]] and half [[demon]].
